pattern.description: After a hard cut to the sentence stem 'One AI tool to', a rounded pill with an icon and the first option 'Ask a question' rises into the slot from below while unblurring; the next pill is already faintly visible below, setting up a vertical cycle of options.
pattern.why_premium: The sentence stem stays fixed while the completion arrives as a real UI chip with soft blur and lift, so the claim reads as both copy and product, and the queued blurred pill promises more options without clutter.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.stem', {opacity:1}); tl.fromTo('.pill', {y:30, opacity:0, filter:'blur(8px)'}, {y:0, opacity:1, filter:'blur(0px)', duration:0.3, ease:'power3.out'}); keep the next pill below at opacity:0.1, blur(6px) ready to cycle up.
build_hint.remotion: Stem rendered from the cut frame. Pill: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:170}}); translateY = interpolate(p,[0,1],[30,0]); opacity = p; filter = `blur(${interpolate(p,[0,1],[8,0])}px)`.

notes: The single-frame energy spike at f105 is the hard cut from the title card; the pill motion follows. A faint, blurred second pill sits below the first (around y~470), probably the next cycle item, not annotated since it barely changes here.
